units.source_text: 匂亲王猜想：“她始终不肯表示愿意跟我出走，而且连回信也没有，

en.t: Prince Niou thought, "She never showed any willingness to run away with me, and she has not even sent a reply,

units.source_text: 大概是由于薰大将劝诱她，她相信依靠他比依靠我合理，就决心跟他走了。”

en.t: probably because General Kaoru persuaded her, and she decided that relying on him made more sense than relying on me, so she resolved to go with him."

units.source_text: 他明知这是当然之事，然而不胜惋惜，妒火燃烧起来。

en.t: He knew perfectly well that this was only natural, yet he could not help regretting it, and the flames of jealousy flared up within him.

units.source_text: 他苦苦寻思：“虽然如此，但她确曾倾心爱我。

en.t: He brooded in anguish: "Even so, she truly did once love me with all her heart.

units.source_text: 定然是和我相别期间，侍女们在她面前说了我的坏话，她就变心了。”

en.t: Surely, while she and I were apart, her attendants spoke ill of me in front of her, and that is why her heart changed."

units.source_text: 便觉“恋情充塞天空里”，忍无可忍，

en.t: Then he felt as though "longing filled the very sky," and, unable to endure it any longer,

units.source_text: 又不顾一切地赴宇治去了。

en.t: he once again cast everything aside and set out for Uji.
